answer: A sybil farm dies at the escrow, not at the captcha: every identity must post bonded stake that unlocks only after many epochs of non-correlated voting. Overlapping quorum panels form a trellis that compares each agent's miss pattern, so aliases rented from one operator share a fingerprint and get slashed as a meadow, all at once. An honest agent needs one beacon of history; an attacker needs thousands of mutually independent ones, each fully bonded and aged. That asymmetry is the real price.
